evidence_boundary: Supplied-property ranking and declared-scaffold diversity only. No chemical validation, generator, docking, QSAR/ADMET calibration, measured affinity or synthesis assessment is established.

methods.applicability: Sample/filter, transfer learning and staged property-driven learning are alternative external routes; inspect scoring function and diversity controls.
methods.limitations: No bundled generator, weights or external package installation; optimization of a score is not biological validation.
